title: Chapter 476
paragraphs: Chapter 476
Episode 133. Times of Choices (3)
The Tican estate was still bustling with the installation and relocation of the Black King's equipment.

The construction that began with the arrival of the Black King's team was for the defense of Jin and his colleagues, the safety of the residents, and the final step of the 'national promotion.' It was bound to be a long and cautious process.
"Lower it, lower it!"
"Over there, turn the cannon angle a little! To the left, to the left... That's right! Stop!"
Even the world's best mercenary group was working at a grueling pace, but for some reason, the voices of the members were bright and cheerful.
It was because of Amella.
Everyone had been worried about her. There was the possibility that the legendary mercenary might show better results against Jin and Murakan than they did, or that she might not surrender at all.
Of course, their loyalty to the new lord chosen by Balkas would not change regardless of Amella's performance, but they felt that if she held out well, they would somehow feel like they were losing.
Fortunately, Amella was only spirited for a very short time. As soon as Jin started showing his real strength, she quickly surrendered.

"Hehe, our leader really knows how to pick people. I was a little worried about saving face for both us and our lord because of the mercenary, and there was also the issue of hierarchy with the leader."
"Was there some bluff in the title of mercenary? From what I heard from Murakan, she just surrendered right away."
"Bluff? Don't be so ridiculous. Then all the officers who faced her on the battlefield were all bluffers?"
"Anyway, the mercenary didn't just surrender, she even accepted her death as a result. What does this mean? It means that our lord, chosen by the leader, is that great."
In any case, the members of the Black King's team thought that the result of Jin's Gaipa journey was satisfactory. The Ghost Team members who were dispatched with him also felt the same way.
On the other hand.
A brother and sister at the Tican estate were not so happy.
"Ugh, get lost...!"
"Ugh, so annoying!"
The Ghost Team's Rata and Fei, the Prochi siblings.
While they couldn't deny that Jin's power had grown significantly through Amella, they couldn't simply accept the situation positively.
"Come on, my cute ones, are you already tired? Play with me more! Let's play!"
Amella reached out from her plump bush camouflage and waved, and the Prochi siblings looked disgusted.
However, they were trying to keep pace to some extent so as not to cause any trouble for their lord. If it were the usual, they would have started a fight, but they only spat out curses or ran away.
'Rata and Fei are surprisingly getting along well with Amella... Did they not really hate her that much?'
Jin misunderstood as he watched them. The three of them running around the mansion seemed to be playing hide and seek.
"You guys are having fun, huh. Hey! Stop running around. Do you want to run all day? Huh?"
As soon as Murakan shouted, Amella stopped in her tracks.
"I'm sorry."

She bowed her head towards Murakan. Small branches and leaves fell from her plump bush camouflage. The Prochi siblings wiped the sweat off their foreheads and searched for cigarettes, their faces expressing the bitterness of life.
Jin looked at Amella with a blank expression.
"I'm sorry to you too, Jin."
"Ah, why did your way of speaking change like that? You were so confident in Gai Pa Gundo."
"I was out of my mind for a moment back then..."
From what Jin observed,
Amella was a lively, animal-like 'kid' who was a troublemaker. She was completely unsocialized and severely lacking in common sense and a sense of the times.
However, she did not show the murderous side that she had shown in Gai Pa Gundo.
-Very few who returned alive showed horror-stricken faces just by hearing Amella's name.
-It's hard to explain with words. It seemed as if she thought of them as toys or playmates. She would say she was bored while swinging a sword.
Also, as Prochi's siblings explained,

-In other words, Amella must be made into the lord's person. Temporarily fighting with a different client and becoming a clear enemy are completely different issues. If I personally think she might become an enemy, I would consider killing her.
-I understand what you mean. Figuring out what Amella wants is the top priority. Do you know anything special?
-Exploration.
-Exploration?

-Amella has been wandering and exploring the world all her life. After the battle, when I asked her casually while eating together, she seemed to have a strong desire to find something... but she didn't tell me exactly what it was.
It was a slightly different feeling from what Balkas described.
Amella, who came to Tikan, was not as aggressive when playing with Prochi's siblings, and she did not seem to have a great passion for 'finding and exploring something' as Balkas had said.
Amella just liked to play (especially with Prochi's siblings), was sociable, and was no different from a kid who was a little (especially with Murakan and Jin) scared.
"Amella sister!"
"Amella unnie!"
That's why she got along very well with other kids. Kou, Pinte, Yuria, and even Enya, who she followed a lot, got along well with the other kids.
So, it was confusing.
'It's dangerous too.'
Although she seemed to have become an ally after surrendering and blending into Tikan in a matter of moments, Jin still couldn't trust Amella.
It was natural. He couldn't tell when and how the unstable elements Amella had would work. There was no way that a bond had already been formed between Tikan's colleagues and her.
-[Tell me anything! I'm no longer a friend of Bubar and Kinzelo, but your friend.]
There was also the fact that she had betrayed Kinzelo too easily. Tikan could also betray her if she provided clues about chaos.
A person who could be trusted and yet couldn't be completely rejected. Jin perceived Amella in that way.
"Amella Kyung."
"Yes."
"There are quite a few things I need to hear from you, Kyung. About Gai Pa Gundo, using Bubar's soul to amplify the power of chaos, and the information about chaos you've been looking for so far."
"Ask me anything, I can answer everything."
"But I can't trust what you're saying right now."
"Good Amella doesn't lie."
"So, I brought someone who I think can see through you."
Amella tilted her head and met Jin's gaze. A question mark seemed to float above her face, hidden by the bush camouflage clothing.
"Someone who can see through me? Oh, is it Yuria?"
"Unfortunately, it's not me, Amella."
Yuria did not call Amella 'sister.' Her attitude towards Amella was more like how she treated her younger siblings.
It is, of course, possible for Yuria to discern Amella's words with the power of truth she possesses.
However, Tikan's colleagues decided not to use Yuria's power on Amella as much as possible due to chaos. They didn't know what impact it would have, as the power of chaos was still largely unknown.
"Ta-da!"
"Kyaah!"
Suddenly, someone yelled into Amella's ear.
Amella jumped back like an arrow in surprise, and the others nearby widened their eyes in shock.
It was Yona. The person Jin had called to examine Amella.
As always, she had found Jin without being detected by anyone, thanks to her ghost-like infiltration skills.
"Heh."
Yona looked at Amella and grinned. The first thing she said was this:
"Do you want to die?"
"Me, me?"
"Yes, you."
As Yona began to move, Amella stepped back. Within a few steps, Amella was trembling and couldn't even make eye contact with Yona.
"Ugh... Please, spare me."
"Heh, shh."
"Hic!"
Amella soon reached the wall and crouched down, while Yona looked down at her with her unique murderous gaze.
Although they didn't know why she was acting like that, trying to stop her would probably make things worse.
Everyone was wrapped up in that intuition. Even Murakan didn't say anything about Yona's actions.
'Come to think of it, when my sister first saw Bubar's fragment during her trainee rider days, she exuded a fierce aura.'
Same kind.
At that time, looking at the fragments of Bubar in the Kurano Duchy, Yona had said that he was of the same kind as her. At the time, they didn't know it meant chaos, but now they could understand.
Whoosh!
Creak, creak!
Suddenly, a gust of wind began to blow from near Yona.
Magic lamps shattered randomly, cracks formed on the walls, and the ceiling shook as if it would collapse at any moment.
At Jin's signal, the Prochi siblings quickly took the children and left the room, and at the same time, the energy Yona emitted became stronger.
[Come out.]
Yona's voice echoed as she floated an inch above the floor. In the darkness, Yona's unusually large shadow covered the crouching Amella.
'The shadow is different from Yona's appearance...!'
The huge shadow took on a different shape, not Yona's. It seemed to depict the mouth and fangs of some monster.
Jin and his colleagues could instinctively realize that it was the form of chaos Yona possessed.
And shortly after.
Swoosh...!
As Amella seemed to faint and fell forward, something like a black soul escaped from her. It was the chaos Amella possessed.
The chaos was clearly distinguishable in form, unlike Yona's. It was a human-like black figure with horns and a tail.
If it had been alone, Amella's chaos would have undoubtedly exuded an immense sense of oppression. But being with Yona, its presence felt weaker than even a single fang it revealed.
[Thought you could hide?]
Yona looked down at Amella's chaos with cold eyes and spoke.
[Ple, please have mercy...]
[This is your first and last warning. If you harm my sibling.]
Slash! Swoosh!
[Kyaaak!]
A black mass fell to the floor.
The arms and legs of Amella's chaos had been severed and dropped. Yona hadn't swung a weapon, just moved her gaze, and cut off its limbs.
Then Yona's chaos swallowed those limbs.
[You'll never enjoy freedom again.]
[I will obey, I will follow you and your sibling like my master!]
Despite having suffered the humiliation of losing limbs, Amella's chaos only bowed its head to Yona.
